title: Charters Towers Stock Exchange Arcade
scope: Standing Royal Arcade at 76 Mosman Street, including its projecting street canopy, paired masonry shop ranges, open passage and glazed steel central vault.
representedDate: Present heritage arcade, with retained 1888 architectural form interpreted from the 1891 archive photograph and standing structure descriptions.
geometryBasis: Named OpenStreetMap footprint and street axis, the original 1891 front photograph, and the standing fabric documented by the National Trust.
sectionBasis: Original street-side DEM datum. Width and depth use the mapped polygon. Clear vault, floor, facade heights and geometry are interpreted from written accounts and historic facade evidence.
limitations: Wall, roof, interior passage and entry dimensions are estimates within the mapped footprint. The roof, street canopy, shop ranges and passage reflect primary descriptions. Painted colors and exact decorative patterns are interpreted from period construction.
The arcade passage and ground-floor glazing are represented. Individual offices, event displays and neighboring businesses are outside scope.
